name: Cursed Omelette
summary:
Survive as several characters and fight the final boss.
All for one: survival.
You have to: go through a cave of obstacles full of secrets and surprises.
Make a dash to a store of seeds through a crowd of enemies, and secret passages.
And defend the shelter from evil opponents, and the culprit of the whole epic!
And at the end, fight the main boss and his minions.
Or you can take an alternative path as a new character and uncover new mysteries of this universe...
